en.name: iRoomCraft
en.short_description: Interior design from room size and your notes, plus real local shops
en.subtitle: Room layout, worked out
en.description:
RoomCraft turns a room's size and purpose into concrete layout advice.

DESIGN
Pick the room type (living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, home office or dining room), enter the square footage, and choose one of six styles: Modern Minimalist, Scandinavian Hygge, Industrial Loft, Mid-Century Modern, Bohemian Eclectic or Japandi. RoomCraft returns a design philosophy, a colour palette, a furniture list for that kind of room in that style, a layout strategy and the clearance guidelines for the room — plus how many pieces the room can actually hold before it stops working.

REDESIGN
Already have notes on what is in the room? Paste them in and RoomCraft works around the fixed elements, giving you a positioning strategy and an ordered set of redesign steps.

SOURCING
Enter a town, address or postcode (or coordinates) and a material, and RoomCraft lists real shops within 15 km — timber merchants, hardware, DIY, tile, fabric and furniture shops — from OpenStreetMap, nearest first, with distances and addresses where OpenStreetMap has them. Sourcing needs an internet connection.

HOW IT WORKS
Design and Redesign are deterministic rules running on your device — the same inputs always give the same advice, and you can see why. There is no camera, no photo upload and no AI model. RoomCraft never asks for an account and never sends your room description anywhere. Sourcing sends only the place or coordinates and the material you enter to OpenStreetMap's public Nominatim and Overpass services. Anonymous crash reports and usage statistics go to Google Firebase so we can fix problems.

ADS
RoomCraft is free and shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure those ads. The app does not track you across other companies' apps or websites, and where the law requires consent (for example in the EEA and the UK) you are asked before any ad is requested.

Shop data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
RoomCraft turns a room's size and purpose into concrete layout advice.

Intended audience:
Room layout, worked out

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting
- Google AdMob (ads) — a banner above the tab bar and an occasional, frequency-capped interstitial when switching tabs; Google's User Messaging Platform asks for consent first where the law requires it, and a "Privacy choices" entry appears in the top-right menu there. No App Tracking Transparency prompt: the app does not track.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
